sloka: सन्ति मे कुशला वैद्यास्त्वभितुष्टाश्च सर्वशः ।सुखितां त्वां करिष्यन्ति व्याधिमाचक्ष्व भामिनि ॥२-१०-३०॥
transliteration: santi me kuśalā vaidyāstvabhituṣṭāśca sarvaśaḥ ।sukhitāṁ tvāṁ kariṣyanti vyādhimācakṣva bhāmini ॥2-10-30॥

translations.english: O lovely one there are, to my best satisfaction, expert physicians in all branches (of medical science). They will restore your health. Tell me your ailment.
